test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: It is given that ΔABC ~ ΔXYZ and Area ΔABC : Area ΔXYZ = 81 : 25. If AB = 18 cm, BC = 10 cm, CA = 15 cm, then what is the side XZ (in cm)?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For similar triangles, the ratio of corresponding sides is equal to the square root of the ratio of their areas.

Ratio of sides (CA / XZ) = √(81 / 25) = 9 / 5

⇒ 15 / XZ = 9 / 5

⇒ XZ = (15 × 5) / 9 = 75 / 9 = 25 / 3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 25/3 cm.**
